name: manual_ba08eb
claim: Place side-effecting setup such as PATH mutation and partner-CLI discovery in CLI launchers after all read-only and lifecycle early-exit handlers, so modes like --stop, --status, --list, --validate, and --fleet-status never run it.

decisions.notes: We moved ensure-partner-cli-paths.ps1 below the --stop / --status / --list / --fleet-status blocks in start.ps1 so a status check does not mutate the environment. Early exits must be truly side-effect free.

rationale: We moved ensure-partner-cli-paths.ps1 below the --stop / --status / --list / --fleet-status blocks in start.ps1 so a status check does not mutate the environment. Early exits must be truly side-effect free.
